facts.en: Completed a diploma in Office Management at Fictional Copperfern Institute in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构铜蕨学院完成办公室管理文凭课程。

facts.en: Completed internal data-handling training in 2025-02; it did not confer a legal qualification.
facts.zh: 2025-02 完成内部数据处理培训；不授予法律资格。

facts.en: Facilities records assistant at Fictional Mosaic Tools, 2019-10 to 2022-08.
facts.zh: 2019-10 至 2022-08 在虚构马赛克工具机构任设施记录助理。

facts.en: People operations assistant at Fictional Mosaic Tools, 2022-09 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2022-09 至 2026-09 在虚构马赛克工具机构任人事运营助理。

facts.en: Maintains starter checklists and routes missing documents to authorized HR colleagues without judging candidate suitability.
facts.zh: 维护新员工核对表，将缺失文件转交获授权的人力资源同事，不判断候选人适合程度。

facts.en: Coordinated 12 starter files in 2026-09; the 2024-07 intake peak was 29 files.
facts.zh: 2026-09 协调 12 份新员工文件；2024-07 入职高峰为 29 份。

facts.en: Co-designed an onboarding checklist revision with an HR advisor during 2025-04 to 2025-05.
facts.zh: 2025-04 至 2025-05 与人力资源顾问共同设计入职核对表修订。

facts.en: Personally added owner and due-date fields; the advisor approved required document categories.
facts.zh: 个人添加责任人及到期日期字段；必需文件类别由顾问批准。

facts.en: A team audit found complete checklist fields in 21 of 25 files in 2025-07 versus 14 of 23 in 2025-03; cohorts differed and causality was not established.
facts.zh: 团队审核发现，2025-07 的 25 份文件中有 21 份核对字段完整，2025-03 的 23 份中为 14 份；群体不同且未建立因果关系。

facts.en: Drafted an exit-document handoff guide in 2026-05; it remained unapproved in 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草离职文档交接指南；2026-09 仍未获批准。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet validation, access-controlled folders, and approved HR email templates.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格校验、访问受控文件夹及经批准的人力资源邮件模板。

facts.en: Escalates payroll questions to payroll staff and policy interpretation to the HR advisor.
facts.zh: 将薪资问题上报薪资人员，将政策解释问题上报人力资源顾问。

facts.en: Created a personal sewing inventory of 47 fabric offcuts in 2024-10, outside work.
facts.zh: 2024-10 在工作以外制作包含 47 块布料余片的个人缝纫库存表。

facts.en: Enjoys mending clothes and walking; neither activity is an HR qualification.
facts.zh: 爱好修补衣物和步行；均非人力资源资格。

facts.en: Helped label supply boxes at Fictional Craft Weekend in 2025-06 while remaining employed full-time.
facts.zh: 2025-06 在虚构手工周末活动中协助标记物资箱，同时保持全职任职。

facts.en: An unverified draft title says HR advisor, whereas signed employment records say people operations assistant.
facts.zh: 一份未经核实的职称草稿称人力资源顾问，而签字任职记录为人事运营助理。

facts.en: A training note lists payroll course complete but has no provider or completion date; completion is unconfirmed.
facts.zh: 一条培训备注列为薪资课程已完成，但无提供方或完成日期；完成情况未经确认。

facts.en: No payroll calculation ownership, legal advice, or candidate ranking is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录薪资计算责任、法律建议或候选人排名经历。
